name: OSRS Melee Weapons Index
description: Equal-weighted, liquidity-capped basket of the most traded melee weapons. Measured over 361 days of daily history this basket returned -8.5% at 16% annualised volatility with a -24.2% maximum drawdown, against constituent volatilities of 0.38%-2.60% daily. The diversification is real; the drift is negative, because gp-denominated gear deflates as drops accumulate. This is a trading instrument, not a savings vehicle.
notes: Abyssal dagger (0.43B gp/24h, 3.70% spread) and Dragon scimitar (0.46B gp/24h, 4.2M gp per 4h window) fail the default screen. They are listed as seeds so the screener rejects them explicitly rather than silently omitting them -- a published index must show its exclusions.
Abyssal dagger is the cheapest attack surface in this basket: ~65M gp (~55 USD) moves the index 1% against a 24h VWAP NAV.
Scythe of vitur is carried uncharged. The charged variant has its own item id and a price that embeds consumed blood runes, which would import a consumable's price into a weapons index.

The candidate pool is deliberately larger than target_size. Membership is decided each review by liquidity rank with entry/exit buffers, so the pool defines what the basket is ABOUT while the rules decide what it HOLDS. Curation cannot be automated away: the API has no item taxonomy.
